notes.title: Desktop support coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32757685/f67d6ea9bc9c00ea4590df364c275eabc37490e7.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Thanks very much for your support over the last couple of months.

Sorry if it seemed like we disappeared there for a while. It is only because we were SUPER busy working on the awesome new updates coming to Number Hunt!

It includes desktop support, so anyone can now play with or without a VR headset.
And LOTS of fixes, updates and new features!

We will be opening up a beta branch soon for testing and feedback from you before we push the update.

Keep you posted. 

Cheers!

- Sunelda

notes.title: Launch update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you so much for your support and feedback during the early access period of Number Hunt. We couldn't have done it without you!

We're leaving early access on the 21st.

Please find below some of the updates included:

[h1]Help Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Demonstration & pictures of controls
[*] Demonstration of Special Blasters
[*] Help features are now also visible in the Exit menu (menu button)
[/list]

[h1]Flying Bots[/h1]
These flying bots take out any numbers in their path! Watch out if one approaches numbers you're chasing. So don't hesitate to shoot them out of existence!

[h1]Player movement updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added rotation
[*] Toggle between rotation and traditional strafing by pressing the grip on your movement controller
[/list]

[h1]Level loading[/h1]
Levels now become available as they are loaded so that you don't have to wait so long every time you want to play.

[h1]Scoreboard in the sky[/h1]
In each map, you will now find one or more scoreboards in the sky. It contains information on the following things about the match:
[list]
[*] Player names
[*] Player current totals
[*] Target numbers
[*] Current round
[*] Match time
[*] The target numbers become the color of the player that scored the target number (E.g. P1=Blue)
[/list]

[h1]AI Players[/h1]
In order to further enhance the single player experience, we added AI players who compete against real players for the target numbers.


Happy Number Hunting!

notes.title: Update: Leaderboards added & Demo achievements + leaderboards fixed
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

New Leaderboards include:
- Most Targets Scored in 2-4 player matches.
- Most Targets Scored in solo matches.

If some of you playing the demo wondered why your entries were not showing up on the leaderboard or why you cannot earn achievements, that is fixed now.

Please let me know if you have any issues. Feedback is much appreciated!

Cheers,

- Sunelda

notes.title: Update: Hosting & Fixes
notes.content:
Updates:
- In 2-4 player mode, each Arena now shows how many rooms and open rooms it currently has.
- In 2-4 player mode, the Quick Join option now shows how many rooms and open rooms are on the entire network.

Fixes:
- Issue where Double Barrel and Divider would create Numbers off available running area.
- Position in Factory when returning from game.
- In 2-4 player mode, the Quick Join option will be disabled if there are no open rooms on the network to join.
